Mission complete

Happy 27th, mahal.

Bee,

I still think it's ridiculous that we started with a random Omegle conversation on September 30, 2020.

I thought you were a hacker. Somehow that suspicious stranger became someone I can spend ridiculous amounts of time talking to — including calls that somehow reached around 20 hours.

I love your kindness. Your empathy. Your laugh. Your voice. Your smile. Your eyes. I love your love for the people around you, your crocheting era, and the way you get genuinely annoyed when I'm wasting time instead of studying.

Most of all, I love the little world we've made together — even though we're still on opposite sides of the world.

I wish I could actually be there tonight, sitting beside you, stealing some cake and annoying you in person.

So for now, this is my tiny substitute.

Happy birthday, my Bee. I love you, mahal.

— Tony

One last secret. You know the word.
